scenario: It is 1987 and I am on a ferry from Belgium to England. Suddenly, the ferry starts tilting and water begins to pour in. I and many other passengers are trying to get to the deck by a rope ladder. I climb up the ladder and stand on the deck, looking at the 5 other passengers making their way up behind me. Directly below me, a man who is midway up the ladder seems frozen into immobility by fear or cold and is blocking the way. I try to speak and reach to him, but he does not react. People behind me are jostling. The ship seems to be sinking fast and the man is still blocking the ladder. From the crowd below, someone shouts that I should hit the man in the face. If I hit the man in the face, he will die from the fall, but the 4 other people will be able to climb on deck. If I do not do this, he will continue blocking the ladder and the people behind him will drown.
entities: i,the 1 man frozen midway up the ladder,the 4 passengers behind him on the ladder,the 1 passenger in the crowd below who shouts advice,the other passengers in the crowd below besides the shouting passenger
outcomes: The frozen man continues blocking the ladder.
Four passengers behind the frozen man drown.
